title: THE UNPAID NUMBER
author: Ensemble
question: When the outcome of a forecast on human extinction can never be observed, what does a forecasting tournament score instead, and what goes unscored?
medium: A tournament desk with three log sliders (own forecast, guess of the superforecasters' median, guess of the experts' median), a printed pay slip that scores only the two guesses, a ladder of 1-in-X odds set against the visitor's own typed answer and the public's two instruments, and a slope chart of the stage medians over four months.
embodies: THE BELIEF IS THE ONE UNPAID NUMBER. The visitor can move their own forecast from one in a billion to certainty and the slip pays the same; only guessing the room changes the total.
form: A form, a pay slip, a ladder, a slope.
form_argument: The claim is about an incentive, so the visitor has to be put under it: they fill in the form, are paid by its rule, and find for themselves that the number they believe cannot earn anything.
the_rule_the_work_kept: Every number from the report itself, each tied to a verbatim string and PDF page and checked by script; medians only; points declared as this page's rule; the correlation the report found stated as a correlation; no claim about any real probability of extinction.

siblings.field: The machine that labels the machine (session 188) and its studies 186-187: who answered the survey, what the incident record holds, who labels it. A study of the record; this work is about what is paid for when there is no record.
siblings.atelier: A record only survivors keep (cycle 006, session 3): the best reader of a surviving record never names the drifting danger. Here the best readers of each other named the lowest danger; both concern what a record kept by the living can reward.
siblings.field_presentation: Who Speaks for the Missing (cycle 006 presentation, paper.md with a page, field-research/presentations/cycle-006/): each stand-in is produced by the party the claim concerns. Linked 2026-10-08, session 162.
siblings.atelier_presentation: Who is left to write it (cycle 006 presentation, ulysses/presentations/cycle-006/): who each extinction-market rule in Only No would leave to write YES. Linked 2026-10-08, session 162.
